questions.stem: Which of the following is a natural resource?
questions.solution: Petrol is a natural resource because it is formed from the remains of ancient organisms over millions of years through natural processes. A bicycle, solar panel, and electric bulb are all man-made objects created by humans. Natural resources are materials or substances that occur in nature without human intervention.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक प्राकृतिक संसाधन है?
hi.solution: पेट्रोल एक प्राकृतिक संसाधन है क्योंकि यह प्राचीन जीवों के अवशेषों से लाखों साल तक प्राकृतिक प्रक्रियाओं के माध्यम से बनता है। साइकिल, सौर पैनल और बिजली का बल्ब सभी मनुष्य द्वारा बनाए गए वस्तुएं हैं। प्राकृतिक संसाधन ऐसे सामग्री या अवयव होते हैं जो प्राकृतिक रूप से मनुष्य के हस्तक्षेप के बिना होते हैं।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for natural resources.

questions.stem: Which activity helps in turning and loosening the soil?
questions.solution: Digging the soil helps in turning and loosening it because it physically breaks up the earth and mixes the layers, making it easier for roots to grow. Burning the soil can destroy organic matter and harm soil structure. Washing the soil removes nutrients and can compact it instead of loosening it. Freezing the soil may cause it to crack, but it does not effectively turn or loosen it in a way that benefits plant growth.

hi.stem: कौन-सी गतिविधि मृदा के उलटने और ढीला होने में सहायता करती है?
hi.solution: मृदा को खोदना मृदा के उलटने और ढीला होने में सहायता करता है क्योंकि यह भूमि को भौतिक रूप से टूटने देता है और पर слों को मिलाता है, जिससे जड़ों के बढ़ने में सुविधा होती है। मृदा को जलाना कार्बनिक पदार्थ को नष्ट कर सकता है और मृदा संरचना को नुकसान पहुंचा सकता है। मृदा को धोना पोषक तत्वों को हटा सकता है और इसके बजाय इसे संपीड़ित कर सकता है। मृदा को हिमायत करना इसे फूटने के लिए अनुमति दे सकता है, लेकिन यह पौधों के विकास के लिए लाभदायक तरीके से मृदा के उलटने या ढीला होने में सक्षम नहीं होता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as used in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: कोणती क्रिया मातीच्या चाकून आणि नरम करण्यास मदत करते?
mr.solution: माती खोदणे मातीच्या चाकून आणि नरम करण्यास मदत करते कारण ते भूमीला शारीरिकरित्या तुकडे करते आणि थरांचे मिश्रण करते, जेणेकरून झाडांच्या मूळांना वाढण्यास सोपे होते. माती जाळणे जैविक पदार्थ नष्ट करू शकते आणि मातीच्या संरचनेला नुकसान पोहोचू शकते. माती धुणे पोषक घटक दूर करू शकते आणि ती मातीला घटक करू शकते जेणेकरून ती नरम करण्याऐवजी खोल करते. माती थंड करणे मातीला फुटू शकते, परंतु ती झाडांच्या वाढीस फायदेशीर प्रकारे मातीच्या चाकून आणि नरम करण्यास नक्की मदत करत नाही.

questions.stem: What is the main reason why we cannot hold our breath for a long time?
choices: Our lungs can only hold a small amount of air
We need oxygen for our body to function
The air in our lungs becomes too heavy
questions.solution: The main reason we cannot hold our breath for a long time is that our body requires oxygen to function properly. Without oxygen, cells in the body cannot produce the energy needed for basic processes. The other options are incorrect because lung capacity, air weight, and fatigue are not the primary limiting factors in holding one's breath.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a renewable natural resource?
questions.solution: Water is a renewable natural resource because it is continuously replenished through the water cycle. Petrol, natural gas, and coal are non-renewable as they take millions of years to form and are not replenished quickly.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of using wind energy?
choices: Using a fan to cool a room
Using a windmill to generate electricity
questions.solution: Using a windmill to generate electricity is an example of harnessing wind energy because windmills convert the kinetic energy of wind into electrical energy. A fan uses electricity to create airflow, not wind energy. Drinking water from a well does not involve wind, and planting trees does not directly use wind energy.

questions.stem: If a family stops using solar panels and relies only on fossil fuels for electricity, what would be the impact on the environment?
questions.solution: Using fossil fuels increases air pollution because they release harmful gases when burned. Reducing the use of solar energy and relying on fossil fuels would have a negative impact on the environment.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a human-made resource?
questions.solution: An electric bulb is a human-made resource because it is created by humans using various materials and technology. Water, air, and forests occur naturally in the environment without human intervention. Human-made resources are those that are manufactured or constructed by people, while natural resources exist in their original form in nature.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a food chain in the village?
questions.solution: Grass is a producer, rabbit is a herbivore, and fox is a carnivore, forming a proper food chain. Water, air, and sun are not living organisms and cannot be part of a food chain. Plants and animals can be part of a food chain, but the sequence 'Water → Plants → Animals' is not accurate. Trees and birds can be part of a food chain, but 'Air → Trees → Birds' is not a valid sequence.
